description: Source code for Android sensors, specifically implementing RotationVectorSensor and GyroDriftSensor classes, handling sensor data processing, activation, and configuration.

classes.name: RotationVectorSensor
classes.description: Sensor class providing rotation vector data based on sensor fusion estimates.

classes.name: GyroDriftSensor
classes.description: Sensor class providing gyroscope bias (drift) data for debugging.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Processes incoming sensor events to produce rotation vector or gyro bias data.

methods.name: setDelay
methods.description: Sets the delay (sampling rate) for the sensor.

methods.name: getSensorType
methods.description: Returns the sensor type based on the mode.

methods.name: getSensorName
methods.description: Returns the sensor name based on the mode.

methods.name: getSensorToken
methods.description: Returns a token identifier for the sensor based on the mode.
